ITEM 1 | Dark brown to near-black charred pieces with uneven browned edges and some lighter tan patches, irregular chunky shapes about 3-5 cm across, mostly dry surface with slight sheen, piled in a mound on the right side of the plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Small tan-to-golden round legumes, roughly 0.8-1 cm each, scattered and clustered over the greens, matte surface with slightly firm texture, some lightly browned spots | 45
ITEM 3 | Fresh loose dark green leaves with thin pale stems, lightly wilted, slightly glossy, spread in a loose bed across the lower right of the plate, covering roughly 8-10 cm in span | 25
